messages:
Alex W: Hey @Maria_G @Devon_R — procurement at AcmeHealth just sent a SIG/CAIQ follow-up. They specifically asked for access-control evidence for the POC: SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement proof, RBAC role matrix, and a short note about least-privilege defaults. Deadline: Fri EOD PST. Can we assemble a bundle?
Maria G: Got it. Do they need screenshots or formal signed artifacts?
Alex W: Screenshots + exported configs are fine. They also want a clear mapping from our controls to SIG v4.0 ID & Access Management questions if possible.
Devon R: I can pull SAML metadata and an extract from our IdP integration guide. Will include the ACS/EntityID example and the enforcement policy for MFA.
Procurement QA: Please include the exact policy name we enforce for MFA and an authoritative link we can reference in the questionnaire. Also we need a contact for security validation calls.
Security Eng: Contact is security-eng@redwood.ai. For evidence: we can provide the SSO SAML metadata XML, an audit log snippet showing MFA prompts, and the RBAC CSV with role->permission mappings. We won't provide private keys obviously.
sigbot: Automated note — SIG/CAIQ: prefilled answers for section 6 (Identity and Access Management) available: https://intra.redwood.dev/sig-prep (internal).
Devon R: Draft SAML example to include (redacted):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood-inference.com/saml">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true" WantAssertionsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/consume"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Devon R: MFA enforcement note to include: we enforce MFA at sign-in for all console/console-admin roles via conditional access policy "mfa-enforce-global" — enforced for SSO sessions and API console flows. We can export a short audit log showing a recent forced MFA event (redacted UIDs).
Alex W: Can we also state our default RBAC stance (least privilege) and show a sample role mapping for the POC?
Security Eng: Yes — default roles are: viewer, editor, deployer, infra-admin. POC default = viewer+limited editor for the trial tenant. We'll attach rbac-poc.csv with columns: role,allowed_actions,resource_scope.
Maria G: I'll assemble a one-page cover letter that maps each requested SIG/CAIQ question to the artifact (SAML metadata, MFA log, RBAC CSV). Will also note the on-call contact for deeper questions.
Procurement QA: Thanks — can you include SSO IdP endpoints and the support runbook steps for onboarding (concise)? They want to know onboarding effort estimate.
Devon R: Onboarding estimate: 1 business day for SAML exchange + 1/2 day for role mapping + optional 1-hour security call. I'll add that to the notes.
Alex W: Perfect. Maria, once you have the bundle, can you drop it here and cc procurement? I'll review before sending.
Maria G: Will do — aiming to post the bundle by Thu morning so we have time to iterate. :thumbsup:
Security Eng: I'll prepare the redacted audit snippet and RBAC CSV now and share before EOD.
Alex W: Thanks team — huge help.
